description: Submit the OTP a user entered to complete verification. On success, returns the verification with status "verified" and attempts_remaining: 0. A wrong code comes back as a 422 VERIFICATION_INVALID_CODE error carrying attempts_remaining (5 attempts total); an expired verification is a 410 VERIFICATION_EXPIRED error; five failed attempts is a 429 VERIFICATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS error; checking one already completed is a 409 VERIFICATION_ALREADY_VERIFIED error. These come back as tool errors to catch, not a status value to branch on.
name: check_verification
title: Check verification code
